report.figure: LTC4368IMS-2#TRPBF drop reason corrected; drop itself stands
report.value: P2's identical drop text for reverse-polarity protection, overvoltage protection and inrush limiting cited JLCPCB C580890 (34/33) as evidence the part has 'no route of rule 5'. C580890 is not this part's own LCSC: read live today it is LTC4368CMS-2#PBF (Commercial grade, tube), stockCount 34, canPresaleNumber 33 -- a different orderable from the Industrial-grade LTC4368IMS-2#TRPBF under review, confirming P3's finding. This part's own LCSC, C688403, read live today, is confirmed as LTC4368IMS-2#TRPBF itself: stockCount 79, canPresaleNumber 77 -- above the gate of 50 (need 5 boards x 2 placements), so sourcing rule 4 (JLCPCB stock) passes for the part actually under review, not fails. The drop still stands, but on rule 5 alone: Digi-Key stock_available is 1 for the #TRPBF suffix (Cut Tape 1, Tape & Reel 0, Digi-Reel 1) and 0 for the #PBF suffix, both far under the gate of 50, and no pin-compatible alternate passing rules 1-4 in the same ideal-diode-OR circuit was identified for it.
